gamerule.ig.dm_percent_global.descriptio:
Base durability percentage for all damageable items. Enter whole percentage integers (e.g., -1 for single-use glass mode, 50 for 50% half durability / 2x wear, 100 for 1x vanilla, 200 for 2x double durability). Do NOT use decimals (such as 0.5). Default: 200.

§6Notice:§r Global configuration settings only define default values for newly generated worlds. For existing worlds, change settings in-game via /gamerule or the GameRules edit GUI screen.
gamerule.ig.dm_percent_weapons.descripti:
Durability percentage for all weapon items (e.g., -1 for single-use, 50 for 50%, 200 for 200%). Do NOT use decimals. Overrides Global if != 0. Set to 0 to use Global value. Default: 0.

§6Notice:§r Global configuration settings only define default values for newly generated worlds. For existing worlds, change settings in-game via /gamerule or the GameRules edit GUI screen.

config.durability-multiplier.title: Durability Multiplier Config
config.durability-multiplier.tooltip_for: Format used when rendering durability modifiers on item tooltips: Adaptive ('2x' for round double/triple, '%' for reductions/fractions), Percentage (always '%'), or Multiplier (always 'x').
config.durability-multiplier.no_modded_i: No custom or uncategorized modded items found. Note: Standard modded weapons, tools, and armor are already automatically handled under the main Percentages, God Mode, and Single-Use categories.
config.durability-multiplier.warning: WARNING: Changes made here only affect the baseline defaults for NEW worlds. To configure your active/existing world, use the in-game /gamerule screen or command instead.
